execution.implementation: Genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation plus exact public Fab chain sequences and deterministic variable-domain motif, charge, pI, and hydrophobic-window calculations

observations: The complete RCSB antibody chain sequences and the analyzed variable-domain lengths are retained.
The Herceptin Fab variable-domain pair has nine motif flags; the pembrolizumab Fab pair has three under the defined motif set.
The largest hydrophobic 9-residue windows contain seven and eight hydrophobic residues, respectively.
A genuine mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open call returned the retained ready response for this case-specific context.
interpretation: The sequence flags nominate regions for structural inspection and controlled experiments; their counts do not establish comparative laboratory developability.
limitations: The analysis omits solvent exposure, full IgG architecture, formulation, concentration, expression host, and conformational dynamics.
Motif presence does not demonstrate chemical degradation.
No laboratory developability, stability, aggregation, viscosity, pharmacokinetic, efficacy, or safety measurement was performed.
The Rosalind operation opened only the task chooser; no Rosalind scientific job was executed.

provenance.note: The launcher observation records the exact Rosalind chooser response and does not represent scientific execution. Exact RCSB chains are trimmed only by documented variable-domain lengths and analyzed locally with inspectable formulas and motif definitions.

reproduction: Run python showcases/rosalind-workbench/cases/rosalind-antibody-developability/scripts/analyze.py from the repository root.
Invoke mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open with task_context therapeutic antibody sequence-liability teaching case, then compare the response with outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json.
Inspect the source sequences, per-chain metrics, motif positions, summary, and SVG preview.
